name: Shop-Refine
prompt: Premium commercial game UI concept for an original modern Korean urban life simulation called Ian Growing. Modern dense pixel art, tired ordinary protagonist, dry humor about work, education, debt, investing. Practical civic design, charcoal ink, muted blue-grey, warm uncoated paper, desaturated jade and selective oxblood seal. Group related data, stepped pixel edges, aligned numerals, restrained ink rules, explicit focus states, readable Korean. Show one finished straight-on game frame. No logos, generic mobile decoration, excessive frames, fantasy or web dashboard. Replace the generic city illustration on the left with the actual shop counter or retail object. Make the wallet balance and currently displayed item prices easy to compare. Keep a compact receipt for feedback after clicking. One standalone, original game screen. Keep all other elements and the established art direction stable.
